projects.title: 35mm-app
projects.shortDescription: 35mm-app is a movie database built with React, Vite, and SASS. It provides a user-friendly platform where users can explore a curated collection of films from various genres and eras.

detailedDescription.overview: 35mm-app: A dynamic movie database built with modern technologies to offer a smooth and enjoyable experience for cinema lovers.

Technologies: Developed with React for component management
TMDb API: This app uses the TMDb API to provide seamless access to a vast collection of movies from various genres and time periods.
Responsive Design: The initial design was created using high-fidelity wireframes in Adobe XD for a structured and organized layout.
During the coding phase, sass was used to implement the design and ensure it aligns with the vision.
This app is fully responsive, designed to provide an optimal viewing experience across all devices, screen sizes, and orientations, ensuring it looks great on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
Key Features: Create and manage a personal favorites list
React Router: Implemented for seamless navigation and a user-friendly experience
Contributions: Assisted in coding React components
Styled UI elements using SASS for a polished look
Organized project structure and optimized stylesheets

projects.title: Call Me Guide

projects.alt: Screenshot of Call Me Guide travel app

detailedDescription.overview: Call Me Guide: A platform offering real-time travel guidance with a user-friendly interface and secure payment integration.

Features: Interactive maps using the Google Maps API
Contributions: Founder and main architect of the platform
Led the overall project management and development of the platform
Coordinated and managed collaboration between frontend, backend, and design teams
Oversaw the entire project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical requirements
Ensured a smooth user experience with real-time updates and seamless navigation
Worked on frontend design and interactivity using React

projects.title: Flag Game
projects.shortDescription: Flag Game is an interactive educational project focused on the provinces and territories of Canada.

detailedDescription.overview: Flag Game: An engaging educational game focused on Canadian geography, developed to enhance users' knowledge of Canada's provinces and territories.

Technologies: Developed using Java for core logic
Features: Interactive gameplay to identify the flags of Canada's provinces and territories
Fun and educational, suitable for students and geography enthusiasts alike
Contributions: Handled the entire project from concept to completion
Designed and implemented the game flow and interaction logic
Developed the core functionality using Java
Created the user interface and visual elements with CSS
Ensured the game is both educational and engaging for users
Managed all aspects of the project, including design, development, and testing

projects.title: pacificpeaks
projects.shortDescription: Pacific Peaks is a website for an adventure tour business offering day and multi-day tours throughout the year, providing users with a seamless experience to explore various adventure packages across all seasons.
projects.alt: Screenshot of Pacific Peaks adventure tour website

detailedDescription.overview: Pacific Peaks is a new business project built with WordPress. The project is currently ongoing and has not been fully launched yet. Pacific Peaks offers adventure tours ranging from one-day to multi-day options in all four seasons with various packages.

Technologies: Custom WordPress theme developed for the platform
Backend PHP code written to handle custom functionalities
Security and SEO plugins integrated for optimization
Features: Booking System: Integrated booking functionality with availability calendars for real-time tour scheduling.
Interactive Maps: Users can view tour routes and destinations via interactive maps.
Contributions: Collaborated in the initial planning phase of the project
Focused on backend development, specifically writing custom PHP code for the WordPress theme
Worked extensively on styling the pages using SASS to ensure a polished and consistent design
Contributed to the integration of WooCommerce and other WordPress functionalities
Helped implement SEO and security plugins to enhance the performance and safety of the website

projects.title: Portfolio Website

Technologies: Built using React for dynamic component management
Styled with SASS for a clean and responsive design
Hosted on SiteGround for reliable performance

Animations: Smooth text and image animations using CSS and Framer Motion
JSON-based Content: All content is dynamically sourced from JSON files for easy updates

Created custom components using React
Styled all UI elements using SASS for consistency and responsiveness

Ensured cross-browser compatibility and fast performance
